title: 국회의원청가및결석에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text: Article 7 (Report of Absence) Where a Member has been unable to attend the National Assembly due to an unavoidable circumstance, the Member shall submit a report of absence to the Speaker, stating the reason for, and the period of, the absence.
